meta.name: eli5
meta.description: WHAT: Explains a codebase, a folder, a feature, a command or a pull request to someone who knows nothing about it, as a PR Lens canvas whose walkthrough builds the picture one part at a time. WHEN: /eli5 <thing>, or asked to explain code simply, for a beginner, a new hire, a non-engineer, or 'like I'm five'. KEYWORDS: eli5, explain like I'm five, explain simply, beginner, onboarding, walkthrough, diagram, PR Lens

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把陌生代码或一次改动讲成一步步的图解漫游,零基础也能跟上
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果新人或非技术同事需要快速看懂一段代码或一个改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn any codebase or pull request into a beginner-friendly visual walkthrough.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if new hires or non-engineers need to understand unfamiliar code or a PR fast.

howto.what: 把代码库、功能、命令或 PR 讲给完全不懂的人听：先写一句人话回答，再生成一个 PR Lens 画布，画面从两个框起逐张长大，读者打开链接按播放看全貌。
howto.when: 输入 /eli5 <东西> 时触发；被要求给初学者、新人等简单解释代码时也会接管。
